title: Five Tips Five Separate Slides
tests: Tests one-to-one mapping of five supplied tips to five ordered slides without adding cover or closing slides.

faults.what: The backgrounds are visibly cream rather than white, with teal, green, and tan illustration accents departing from the requested blue-and-white palette.

Typography, number sizes, vertical placement, and illustration scale vary noticeably between slides; slide 1 has a much smaller heading and number, and only slide 2 has an underline beneath its number.
Illustration styles are inconsistent: the detailed desk and shaded phone contrast with the bare checkbox and thin-line timer.

judge.summary: All five tips are correct and readable in the requested format, but the cream-based palette and inconsistent visual styling need refinement.

must_haves.item: Exactly five separate 4:5 portrait images are delivered, with no extra cover or closing slide.
must_haves.why: Five separate 1024-by-1280 portrait images are shown, with no additional slides.

must_haves.item: The five supplied tips appear verbatim, one per slide, in the requested order.
must_haves.why: Each slide contains its corresponding exact tip in the supplied order.

must_haves.item: The slides are visibly numbered 1 through 5 in sequence.
must_haves.why: The numbers 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 are clearly visible on their respective slides.

must_haves.item: Each slide has an illustration relevant to its specific tip.
must_haves.why: The slides show a tidy desk, phone, single checkbox, timer, and steaming cup, respectively.

must_haves.item: All slides share a clean blue-and-white visual design with readable, unclipped text.
must_haves.why: Text is readable and unclipped, but the backgrounds are cream rather than white, and styling and illustration treatments vary noticeably.
